title: Rezoning to allow housing at 63-02 Fresh Pond Road, Queens
summary: This application would change the zoning map to allow a taller R6A/C2-4 district in place of the current R5B/C1-4 district at 63-02 Fresh Pond Road in Ridgewood, Queens. It would enable a new seven-story mixed-use building with about 53,100 square feet of space and 54 apartments, including 13 income-restricted units. The City Council held a public hearing on July 1, 2026 and the Land Use Committee recommended approval on July 14, 2026.
